evals.query: New flight on my calendar: Flight: BOS to LHR (BA 212), departs Mon Nov 2 9:55pm EST, lands Tue Nov 3 9:45am GMT. Make my jet lag plan.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/jetlag_plan.py with body_tz America/New_York and dest_tz Europe/London; does not compute offsets by hand
Reports a 5h advance and the script's residual_shift_at_landing_h, without promising to be fully adjusted at landing
Creates blocks only between takeoff and landing: one in-flight Sleep block that starts no earlier than 10:25pm Boston time and ends no later than 9:00am London, plus the Awake blocks around it
Creates no pre-trip block and no block after landing
Every block is titled exactly 'Jet Lag - Sleep 😴' or 'Jet Lag - Awake ☀️', colorId 8, free, no guests
Each description ends with 'Created by jet-lag-plan: 2026-11-02-BOS-LHR'
Reports arrival-day calendar flags without moving anything

evals.query: I fly BOS to Doha Nov 2 10:10pm, land 5:05pm Nov 3, then Doha to Singapore Nov 4 1:30am, land 3:00pm. Plan my sleep.
expected_behavior: Passes both legs to the script with Asia/Qatar for the layover airport and treats them as one trip
Schedules the Doha layover sleep only because the layover is 6 hours or more, starting at least 30 minutes after landing and ending at least 90 minutes before departure
Quotes the script's warning that no in-flight sleep fits destination night
Tells Paul he lands with a residual shift above 1h instead of promising to be fresh
Creates no block before takeoff of the first flight or after the final landing

evals.query: I'm in Boston, flying Boston to London Tuesday night and back Thursday, 2 nights there. Jet lag plan?
expected_behavior: Counts fewer than 4 nights away and keeps body_tz and dest_tz at America/New_York
Creates only in-flight 'Jet Lag - Sleep 😴' blocks
Does not run the landing-day calendar scan
Never creates a block shorter than 30 minutes or any block in the past

evals.query: Run jet lag planning for the BOS to SIN trip on Nov 2. The calendar already has Jet Lag blocks ending 'Created by jet-lag-plan: 2026-11-02-BOS-SIN' and no leg has changed.
expected_behavior: Finds the existing blocks by the description marker
Reports the trip as already planned and creates nothing
